scenario.name: m3_wash_closed_loop
scenario.description: Pressure sensor at the mesh and outlet absorbance on: the model is corrected as the run goes.

events.narration: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer behind the weir.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 3 simulated (0 rejected): load 14.7 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 22 s, 63.2% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

events.narration: Wash 2 x 39.7 uL (the volume of three 20 uL washes, cut to fit the chamber): buffer flows past the weir to waste while the capsules stay behind it.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 20 simulated (8 rejected): exchange 3 x 39.7 uL wash_buffer at 40 uL/min + 29 s soak, predicted 208 s, 100.0% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.911 after 32 uL: leftover old liquid -23% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Wash 2 x 39.7 uL (the volume of three 20 uL washes, cut to fit the chamber): buffer flows past the weir to waste while the capsules stay behind it. (re-planned)
events.explanation: Re-planned after a model update: Fastest safe option of 20 simulated (4 rejected): exchange 2 x 39.7 uL wash_buffer at 40 uL/min + 38 s soak, predicted 158 s, 100.0% exchanged, peak 2.46 kPa.

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.965 after 48 uL: leftover old liquid +16% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Back-flush from the far side to lift the capsules off the weir and resuspend them.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 8 simulated (5 rejected): exchange back-flush 1 x 39.7 uL resuspension_buffer at 60 uL/min, predicted 40 s, 94.2% exchanged, peak -3.70 kPa.

reasons: predicted 3.70 kPa lifting off the retention is above 70% of the 5 kPa escape pressure

model_updates.reason: outlet absorbance 0.951 after 40 uL: leftover old liquid -16% vs the model since the exchange began

events.narration: Flush the washed capsules out through the release outlet: 44.1 uL at 30 uL/min. The volume is about three trap volumes because a release has to SWEEP the chamber, not just fill it, and the flow is the lift flow because below it the capsule bed does not come off the weir.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 9 simulated (3 rejected): release 53.6 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 80 s, 99.9% exchanged.
